brandStory: Cyclone is the premium motorcycle brand of the Zongshen Group (written Zonsen on Cyclone's own site), a Chinese manufacturer founded in 1982 that researches, develops and builds motorcycles, engines and components. Cyclone describes its models as pure, functional designs shaped by decades of experience with riders of every generation.

models.name: RX2
models.tagline: Liquid-cooled 125 adventure bike with ABS, traction control, luggage
summary: The Cyclone RX2 is a 125 cc adventure bike built for riders who want to leave the tarmac now and then. A liquid-cooled DOHC four-valve single makes 15 PS, fed by fuel injection and driven through a six-speed gearbox. Long-travel suspension, a 19-inch front wheel and tubeless off-road tyres set it apart from road-biased learner bikes.

Equipment is generous for the class: dual-channel ABS, traction control, full LED lighting and a 5-inch TFT dash with Mirror Link. It leaves the factory with a three-case luggage kit, crash bars, hand guards, a tall screen, engine and fork protection and a low front mudguard, so customers can ride straight out on a trip.

Dual-channel ABS and traction control as standard
5-inch TFT dash with Mirror Link phone connection
Three-case luggage kit, crash bars and hand guards included

820 mm seat and 14 L tank

rows: 150 kg, plus 15 kg for cases and fittings

First service at 1,000 km, then every 3,000 km or 1 year

models.name: Carrera
models.tagline: Air-cooled 125 trail bike on 19/17-inch spoked wheels with a 16 L tank
summary: The Cyclone Carrera is an air-cooled 125 cc trail bike aimed at commuters and new riders who want adventure styling at a lower entry point. Its fuel-injected four-valve single produces 12.64 PS and drives a five-speed gearbox. Spoked wheels, 19 inches at the front and 17 at the rear, help it cope with broken surfaces and gravel tracks.

Weight is a manageable 141 kg and the 16-litre tank gives it useful range. Braking uses a combined system (CBS) with a three-piston front caliper. An LCD dash, full LED lighting and hand guards come as standard. Dealers can offer it in three versions: Standard, Urban with a top case, and Explorer with top case, side cases and crash bars.

The full version makes 59.16 PS and 55 Nm, and a 47.5 PS version suits A2 licence holders, so one model covers two groups of buyers. Spoked wheels in 19 and 17 inches run tubeless tyres.

Adjustable suspension at both ends, switchable dual-channel ABS and traction control give riders confidence on mixed surfaces. A TFT dash with Mirror Link, tyre pressure monitoring, backlit switchgear, an aluminium handlebar and full LED lighting are standard. Crash bars are included, and the Urban and Explorer versions add an aluminium top case or a full three-case kit.

models.name: RX4
models.tagline: 401 cc twin-cylinder adventure bike for A2 riders, slipper clutch
summary: The Cyclone RX4 is a 401 cc twin-cylinder adventure bike designed for A2 licence holders who want a step up from a 125. The eight-valve liquid-cooled engine has Bosch fuel injection, makes 36.2 PS and uses an anti-hop slipper clutch. Spoked wheels in 19 and 17 inches carry tubeless tyres for mixed road and trail riding.

Chassis hardware includes a 41 mm upside-down fork adjustable for preload and rebound, and twin 305 mm front discs with four-piston calipers and switchable dual-channel ABS. A TFT dash with phone connection and tyre pressure monitoring, backlit switchgear, an AGM battery and crash bars are standard. Urban and Explorer versions add an aluminium top case or a full case set.

models.name: RA1000
models.tagline: 996 cc V-twin with Bosch ABS, traction control and a 240 rear tyre
summary: The Cyclone RA1000 is the flagship of the range: a 996 cc 90-degree V-twin making 106.73 PS and 95 Nm, in a long, low chassis with a 240-section rear tyre and a 780 mm seat. It is aimed at experienced riders who want muscular styling and big-twin torque rather than outright sport performance.

Bosch ABS and traction control work with J.Juan brakes, including four-piston calipers on twin 320 mm front discs. Suspension is a 48 mm upside-down fork and a fully adjustable direct-mount rear shock. Pirelli tyres, a 6-inch TFT dash, keyless ignition and a lithium battery are standard, and the frame mixes steel tube and aluminium.

models.name: BATTLO
models.tagline: Liquid-cooled 125 naked with upside-down fork, ABS and LED lighting
summary: The Cyclone BATTLO is a 125 cc naked bike with sharp, forward-leaning styling aimed at younger riders who want a sporty look on a learner licence. A liquid-cooled DOHC four-valve single produces 15 PS and 11 Nm, and the bike weighs 149 kg. A 765 mm seat keeps it approachable for shorter riders.

The chassis uses a 37 mm upside-down fork and a preload-adjustable monoshock, with wave-style discs and ABS at both ends. Full LED lighting, a colour LCD dash, tubeless tyres on 17-inch aluminium wheels, a dual seat and an AGM battery come as standard, and the 13-litre tank gives sensible range for commuting.

Spoked wheels, 18 inches at the front and 15 at the rear, carry wide 130-section rear rubber for a proper custom stance. Braking uses a combined system (CBS) with a three-piston front caliper on a 267 mm disc. A round digital LCD dash and full LED lighting give it a modern touch, and the 13-litre tank suits daily use.

models.name: RT2
models.tagline: 289 cc maxi scooter with front and rear cameras and traction control
summary: The Cyclone RT2 is a 289 cc maxi scooter for commuters who need motorway pace and plenty of equipment. Its liquid-cooled DOHC four-valve single makes 24 PS and 24.5 Nm through a CVT automatic. Front and rear cameras, keyless ignition and a TFT dash with Mirror Link set it apart from simpler scooters in this size.

Dual-channel ABS, traction control and tubeless tyres look after safety, with a 270 mm front disc. The screen adjusts for height, the rear shock adjusts for preload, and there is room for a full-face helmet under the seat. Backlit switchgear, full LED lighting and a 12-litre tank complete a practical, well-specified package.
